title: Little Minnesota
cn: 第 11 集 · 小明尼苏达
novel:
Marshall felt [[homesick|homesick]] for Minnesota. Christmas was coming, and he [[missed|miss]] his family's [[traditions|tradition]]. New York felt cold and [[lonely|lonely]] without them.

Robin took Marshall to a Minnesota-themed bar called "Little Minnesota." The moment they walked in, Marshall felt a [[warmth|warmth]] he had not felt in years. The bar was [[decorated|decorate]] with Minnesota [[memorabilia|memorabilia]] — hockey sticks, fishing photos, and Vikings banners.

"This is [[incredible|incredible]]," Marshall [[whispered|whisper]]. He [[ordered|order]] a [[local|local]] beer and felt [[nostalgic|nostalgic]].

Robin introduced Marshall to the bar's [[regulars|regular]]. They were all from Minnesota, and they welcomed Marshall like family. They [[reminisced|reminisce]] about [[childhood|childhood]] winters, [[frozen|freeze]] lakes, and hot dish dinners.

But Marshall had a secret. He had told the regulars that Robin was from Canada, not Minnesota. He was [[embarrassed|embarrass]] to admit his friend was not from his home state.

Robin [[discovered|discover]] the lie and was [[hurt|hurt]]. "Why would you lie about me?" she asked.

Marshall [[hesitated|hesitate]]. "I wanted to fit in. I'm sorry."

Robin [[forgave|forgive]] him. "Just don't do it again."

They sat together at the bar, drinking Minnesota beer and singing old songs. Marshall realized that home was not just a place — it was the people you shared it with.

homesick.en: feeling sad because you are away from home

miss.en: to feel sad about someone who is not with you

tradition.en: something people do regularly for a long time

lonely.en: feeling sad because you are alone

decorate.en: to make a place look nice with things

memorabilia.en: objects kept because they are special

incredible.en: very good or hard to believe

order.en: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant

local.en: from the area where you are

nostalgic.en: feeling happy and sad about the past

regular.en: someone who goes to a place often

childhood.en: the time when you are a child

freeze.en: to turn into ice from cold

forgive.en: to stop being angry at someone
